definitions.explanation: A framework of thin bars crossing each other, as on traditional windows and doors; also a grid or a checked pattern on cloth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{格子|こうし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧はまって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The window has a lattice fitted.

examples.japanese: {格子|こうし}⟦{柄|がら}→柄：02609_gara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。

⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{町家|まちや}→町家：22291_machiya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{格子|こうし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many of Kyoto's old townhouses have beautiful wooden latticework.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {格子|こうし}{戸|ど}: lattice door
- {格子|こうし}{窓|まど}: lattice window
- {格子|こうし}⟦{柄|がら}→柄：02609_gara⟧: checked pattern
- {鉄|てつ}{格子|ごうし}: iron bars (on a window or cell)

WATCH OUT:
⟦{子牛|こうし}→子牛：27912_koushi⟧ (calf) and ⟦{講師|こうし}→講師：00451_koushi⟧ (lecturer) share the reading. In compounds, rendaku sometimes turns it into ごうし ({鉄格子|てつごうし}).
